characters.Kai: src/anim/cast.py KAI - lucky red Hawaiian shirt, shorts, flip-flops (bag lost)
characters.Ruth: 71, retired ski instructor, grey hair, teal parka and knit hat, calm and sharp
characters.The man on the cable: red ski patrol jacket, pale, fixed smile, frosted goggles; no breath fog
characters.Patroller Dee: real ski patrol, red jacket, ponytail (Part 3)

scenes.narration: ~Trust him? A ski patroller is standing on the cable in a blizzard, asking Kai to open the door.
scenes.visual: recap: figure outside the window, TRUST HIM?

scenes.narration: Kai's hand was already on the latch. Rescue. Finally.
scenes.visual: Kai's hand on the latch, relief

scenes.narration: But Ruth didn't move. She was staring at the man's feet.
No harness. No rope. Nothing clipped to the cable. He was just standing there, in wind that could flip a truck.
scenes.visual: the man's boots on the bare cable, nothing attached

scenes.narration: Ma'am, the man said. The cable is failing. You have to come now.
scenes.visual: the man at the glass, calm smile

scenes.narration: His voice was calm. Too calm. And his breath didn't fog the glass.
scenes.visual: close on the glass in front of his mouth: clear

scenes.narration: Kai's breath fogged everything. Ruth's did too. The man's didn't.
scenes.visual: inside: Kai and Ruth breathing clouds; outside: nothing

scenes.narration: Patrol doesn't come out in a storm like this, Ruth whispered. Not alone. Not ever.
Kai took his hand off the latch. Thanks, he said. We'll wait.
scenes.visual: Kai pulls his hand back, determined

scenes.narration: The man's smile didn't change. He just kept knocking. Slow. Patient.
Kai's legs were going numb. His shorts had frozen stiff and split right at the knee.
Could be worse, he said through chattering teeth. Then the window cracked.
scenes.visual: Kai trying to smile; crack shoots across the glass

scenes.narration: A thin line ran across the glass, right where the man was knocking.
scenes.visual: close: crack across the window at the knuckles

scenes.narration: Ruth was shivering hard. Then she stopped. That is worse. When the shivering stops, the cold is winning.
scenes.visual: Ruth goes still, eyes heavy; WHEN SHIVERING STOPS

scenes.narration: Kai pulled her close and gave her every bit of heat he had.
scenes.visual: Kai wraps his arms around Ruth

scenes.narration: Outside, the knocking stopped. Kai looked up. The man was gone.
Then the gondola dipped. Hard. As if something heavy had just climbed onto the roof.
scenes.visual: exterior: cabin dips, a dark shape on the roof

scenes.narration: Hold on? Tell me in the comments. Part three is up next.
